recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆比紅血球大約兩倍的淋巴球，核略呈腎形、染色質成塊，細胞質豐富淡藍且散布細小紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granule）；豐富細胞質內的嗜天青顆粒就是大顆粒淋巴球（large granular lymphocyte, LGL）的辨識重點。
features: Medium to large lymphocyte about twice the diameter of a red cell
Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm with low N:C ratio
Fine to coarse azurophilic granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Background red cells normochromic and normocytic; small platelet clump nearby
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large granular lymphocyte with an indented nucleus, condensed chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing scattered azurophilic granules. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic, and platelets are present. A single cell does not establish a diagnosis; a persistent absolute large granular lymphocyte count above 2 x 10^9/L with clonality demonstrated by flow cytometry (CD3+, CD8+, CD57+) and TRG/TRB rearrangement or STAT3 mutation is required for T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular lymphocytosis (viral infection, post-transplant, splenectomy)
ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs are morphologically identical and polyclonal, and the increase is transient.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell LGLs look the same but are surface CD3-negative, CD56-positive with no TCR rearrangement.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia shows larger atypical cells with irregular nuclei, visible nucleoli and more basophilic cytoplasm, often EBV positive.
Hairy cells have circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei with spongy chromatin but lack azurophilic granules.
